## Fork setup

Start with the [pinned offline quickstart](quickstart.md). The search scripts
import shared infrastructure from that checkout. Update the
[manuscript configuration](manuscript/config.yaml), the corpus, and the
citation sidecars when giving a fork its own publication identity.

The committed `output/` is a publication snapshot. Regenerate outputs in a
detached worktree. The [output guide](output_conventions.md) describes the
generated manuscript, plots, and separate deep-search evidence.
